repeated_line_visits.scope:
Qualify repeated demand-line visits for the three reported gather rows.

Re-execute the frozen target ELF, retain every actual data-access address and
width, and prove each access stays in one 32-byte line. Only then is the sum of
load/store accesses reported as line visits. PREF and cache misses are separate.

model_scope.cold: initially cold 8 KiB I-cache, same exact dynamic instruction trace, synthetic ELF placement; D-cache remains perfect
model_scope.bus: no DMA or SQ cost; no credited RAM-PREF latency benefit
model_scope.trace: actual retired scalar instructions including delay slots; unsupported instructions/unmapped memory fail closed
model_scope.payload_lines: Each region uses actual addresses. Distinct lines in adjacent regions may overlap; do not sum region unions to infer total union.
model_scope.repeated_lines: Only the three address-qualified gather rows use access count as demand-line visits. Guard-dependent c8 segment unions are deliberately omitted.
